metadata.subtitle: Async team health and delivery signals for distributed product teams

vision.text: Help distributed product teams detect collaboration and delivery friction early enough to act before it becomes a quarterly surprise.

target_users.text: Product and engineering managers leading distributed teams of roughly 6–15 people.

problems_needs.text: Managers often learn about delivery or collaboration problems only after deadlines slip or engagement drops.
Team members experience repeated status requests across meetings and chat.

current_alternatives.text: Weekly status meetings, manual Slack follow-ups, project dashboards, and manager intuition.

value_proposition.text: A lightweight recurring pulse that turns team signals into a small number of actionable patterns without adding another long meeting.

business_outcomes.text: Create a repeatable subscription product for teams that already use collaboration and delivery tools.

success_metrics.name: Percent of surfaced signals that lead to a team action

key_capabilities.text: Pattern detection across pulse responses and delivery context.
Action-oriented team view rather than individual performance scoring.

assumptions_risks.text: Teams will answer a recurring pulse often enough to produce useful signal.
Managers will trust aggregated signals without interpreting them as employee surveillance.

evidence.text: No validated customer evidence has been attached to this example.

open_questions.text: Which existing workflow would users replace or reduce if this worked?
What signal is useful enough that a manager would act on it within a week?
What privacy expectations would block adoption?
